ninja:
wibo = 

pool downloads
  depth = 1
rule download
  command = $tools download $tool $out
  description = DOWNLOAD $out
  pool = downloads
rule mwcc
  command = cmd /c set MWCIncludes=include/libc&& $wibo $compiler_command $cflags -MD $in -o $out && $tools transform-dep $stem.dep $out
  description = MWCC $in
  depfile = $out.d
  deps = gcc
rule mwcc_pro4
  command = cmd /c set MWCIncludes=include/libc&& $wibo $compiler_command $cflags
  description = MWCC $in
rule configure
  command = $tools configure --version GC_1_0 --mode compare
  generator = 1

version = GC_1_0
build build/tools/objdiff-cli: download
  tool = objdiff-cli
build build/compilers/ok build/compilers/GC/1.0/mwcceppc.exe build/compilers/GC/1.1/mwcceppc.exe build/compilers/GC/1.1p1/mwcceppc.exe build/compilers/GC/1.2.5/mwcceppc.exe build/compilers/GC/1.2.5n/mwcceppc.exe build/compilers/GC/1.3/mwcceppc.exe build/compilers/GC/1.3.2/mwcceppc.exe build/compilers/GC/2.6/mwcceppc.exe build/compilers/GC/2.7/mwcceppc.exe: download
  tool = compilers
build lib/ok lib/runtime/cexc.obj lib/runtime/ccinit.obj lib/win32sdk/KERNEL32.LIB: download
  tool = lib
build build/compilers/pro4/mwcc.exe: download
  tool = pro4
build build/compilers/pro5/mwcc.exe build/compilers/pro5/lmgr326b.dll: download | tools/lmgr_stub/lmgr326b.dll
  tool = pro5
build build/compilers/pro53/mwcc.exe build/compilers/pro53/lmgr326b.dll: download | tools/lmgr_stub/lmgr326b.dll
  tool = pro53
build build/GC_1_0/compiled/src/a.c.obj: mwcc src/a.c | build/compilers/pro53/mwcc.exe || lib/ok
  cflags = -c -O4,p -inline auto,deferred -sym off "-DMSG=one two" -DVERSION=0 "-Iinclude extra" -Iinclude -i- -Isdk -Iinclude/libc
  stem = a
  compiler_command = build\compilers\pro53\mwcc.exe
build build/GC_1_0/compiled/src/runtime/main.c.obj: mwcc_pro4 src/runtime/main.c | build/compilers/pro4/mwcc.exe || lib/ok
  cflags = /c /O4 /sym on /DVERSION=0 /Iinclude /i- /Iinclude/libc src/runtime/main.c /Fobuild/GC_1_0/compiled/src/runtime/main.c.obj
  compiler_command = build\compilers\pro4\mwcc.exe
build build/GC_1_0/compiled/src/driver/CLWriteObjectFile.c.obj: mwcc src/driver/CLWriteObjectFile.c | build/compilers/pro5/mwcc.exe || lib/ok
  cflags = -c -O4 -DVERSION=0 -Iinclude -i- -Iinclude/libc
  stem = CLWriteObjectFile
  compiler_command = build\compilers\pro5\mwcc.exe
build build/GC_1_0/compiled/src/local.cpp.obj: mwcc src/local.cpp | build/compilers/pro53/mwcc.exe || lib/ok
  cflags = -c -O4 -DVERSION=0 -Iinclude -i- -Iinclude/libc
  stem = local
  compiler_command = build\compilers\pro53\mwcc.exe
rule extract
  command = $tools compare extract $version
  description = EXTRACT $version
rule compare
  command = $tools compare compare $version
  description = COMPARE $version
rule report
  command = $tools compare report $version
  description = REPORT $version
build build/GC_1_0/target/ok: extract | build/compilers/GC/1.0/mwcceppc.exe config/GC_1_0/config.json config/GC_1_0/functions.json config/GC_1_0/bindings.json config/sources.json $tools_dep
build build/GC_1_0/ok objdiff.json: compare | build/GC_1_0/target/ok build/GC_1_0/compiled/src/a.c.obj build/GC_1_0/compiled/src/runtime/main.c.obj build/GC_1_0/compiled/src/driver/CLWriteObjectFile.c.obj build/GC_1_0/compiled/src/local.cpp.obj
build build/GC_1_0/report.json: report | build/GC_1_0/ok build/tools/objdiff-cli
build all_source: phony build/GC_1_0/compiled/src/a.c.obj build/GC_1_0/compiled/src/runtime/main.c.obj build/GC_1_0/compiled/src/driver/CLWriteObjectFile.c.obj build/GC_1_0/compiled/src/local.cpp.obj
build progress: phony build/GC_1_0/report.json
build build.ninja: configure | $tools_dep config/sources.json config/GC_1_0/config.json
default build/GC_1_0/ok all_source
